verdict.rationale: Mixpanel is a SaaS analytics product with AI features (MCP server, AI replay summaries, agents), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no documented control or policy preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. GDPR deletion APIs and EU data residency are adjacent privacy controls, not an AI-training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
